description: This file defines the AppSetupUtility class, which provides utility functions for setting up the application environment, managing database connections and migrations, and inserting initial configuration data for the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: AppSetupUtility
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for application setup, database management, schema migrations, and configuration initialization for OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getConfigHelper
methods.description: Lazy initializer for ConfigHelper instance.

methods.name: getSystemConfiguration
methods.description: Lazy initializer for SystemConfiguration instance.

methods.name: getMigrationHelper
methods.description: Lazy initializer for MigrationHelper instance.

methods.name: createNewDatabase
methods.description: Creates a new database schema using Doctrine's schema manager.

methods.name: connectToDatabaseServer
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database server without selecting a specific database.

methods.name: isDatabaseExist
methods.description: Checks if a database with the specified name exists.

methods.name: isDatabaseUserExist
methods.description: Checks if a database user exists in MySQL.

methods.name: connectToDatabase
methods.description: Establishes a connection to an existing database.

methods.name: isExistingDatabaseEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the connected database has no tables, indicating it is empty.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Creates or verifies the database as per installation mode (new or existing).

methods.name: insertSystemConfiguration
methods.description: Inserts initial system configuration data including CSRF keys, organization info, admin user, and language settings.

methods.name: insertCsrfKey
methods.description: Generates and inserts a CSRF secret key into configuration.

methods.name: insertOrganizationInfo
methods.description: Inserts organization info into the database.

methods.name: insertSubunitOrganizationName
methods.description: Updates subunit organization name in database.

methods.name: setDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Sets default language configuration.

methods.name: insertAdminEmployee
methods.description: Inserts an admin employee record into the database.

methods.name: insertAdminUser
methods.description: Creates an admin user account with hashed password.

methods.name: updateUniqueIdForAdminEmployeeInsertion
methods.description: Updates the unique ID sequence after admin employee insertion.

methods.name: insertInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Inserts or retrieves an instance identifier for the installation.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Generates a unique instance identifier.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifierData
methods.description: Gathers data used to generate a unique instance identifier.

methods.name: createDBUser
methods.description: Creates database users with appropriate privileges after installing on a new database.

methods.name: getUserCreationQueries
methods.description: Returns SQL queries to create users and assign privileges.

methods.name: writeConfFile
methods.description: Generates and writes the configuration file from a template.

methods.name: writeKeyFile
methods.description: Creates a security key file for encryption.

methods.name: getVersionsInRange
methods.description: Returns a list of migration versions within a specified range.

methods.name: runMigrations
methods.description: Runs schema migrations from one version to another.

methods.name: runMigrationFor
methods.description: Runs migration scripts for a specific version.

methods.name: throwMigrationErrorIfPreviousIncomplete
methods.description: Checks if previous migration is incomplete and throws error if so.

methods.name: _runMigration
methods.description: Executes a single migration class's 'up' method.

methods.name: disableExecutionTimeLimit
methods.description: Removes time limits for long migrations.

methods.name: getCurrentProductVersionFromDatabase
methods.description: Retrieves the current product version stored in the database.

methods.name: cleanUpInstallOnFailure
methods.description: Drops all tables and disables foreign key checks to clean up after failed install.

methods.name: dropDatabase
methods.description: Drops the configured database.
